Heard Sri Digvijai Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Anurag Varma, learned
Additional Government Advocate for the State.
2. In view of the proposed order, the notice to opposite party No.4 is hereby dispensed with.

3. By means of this anticipatory bail application, the present applicant has prayed for grant of
anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.0100 of 2018, under Sections 406, 419, 420, 467, 468 & 471
I.P.C., Police Station-Kotwali Hussainganj, District-Lucknow.

4. However, after arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for the applicant has confined
his prayer to the effect that the present applicant may be permitted to appear before the court
concerned within a period of three weeks and may file his regular bail application and direction may

5.  Considering the aforesaid innocuous request of learned counsel for the applicant, on that the learned Additional Government Advocate has no objection, the liberty is given to the present applicant to appear/surrender before the learned trial court concerned within three weeks from today and file his regular bail application and if the present applicant appears/ surrenders before the learned trial court concerned within the aforesaid stipulated time and files his regular bail application, such regular bail application may be considered and decided by the learned trial court concerned with expedition, strictly in accordance with law by affording an opportunity of hearing to the parties concerned and without giving any unnecessary adjournment to the prosecution.
6. In view of the aforesaid observations and directions, the instant anticipatory bail application is disposed of finally.
